data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Najid', meaning 'to be victorious' or 'to find'. In Islamic tradition, Najeedah is believed to symbolize the inner strength and resilience of a woman. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Najeedah usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
